title: An action potential
caption: From a resting potential of about −70 mV, a stimulus that reaches the threshold (about −55 mV) opens voltage-gated Na⁺ channels: depolarisation to about +40 mV. Then Na⁺ channels close and K⁺ channels open (repolarisation), the potential briefly undershoots below −70 mV (hyperpolarisation), and the resting potential is restored. The time axis is schematic.
alt: A trace of membrane potential with its phases labelled depolarisation, repolarisation and hyperpolarisation: flat at -70 millivolts, a stimulus rising to the -55 millivolt threshold, a sharp rise to +40, a fall to about -80 below the resting level, and a return to -70.
description: A stimulus raises the potential to the threshold, about −55 mV.
Depolarisation: Na⁺ floods in and the potential rises to about +40 mV.
Repolarisation: Na⁺ channels close, K⁺ channels open and K⁺ leaves.
Hyperpolarisation: the potential briefly falls below −70 mV.
